name: Windsor.ai for Social Media
description: Windsor.ai for Social Media is a focused workspace for organic social. It connects your social accounts, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile, so you can ask questions in plain language: compare reach, engagement, and follower growth across channels; and see which posts performed best. Where the platform supports it, you can also publish posts (for example on Instagram, Facebook, and Google Business Profile), always after you confirm. It connects only your social sources, so the tools stay on task. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai for Social Media to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai for Social Media to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/social_media. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai for Social Media MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Social Media lists 18 MCP tools, including contact_windsor, create_custom_field, create_destination_task, execute_action, get_connector_authorization_url, get_connector_connect_info, get_connectors, get_current_user, get_custom_fields, get_data, get_destination_setup_info, and get_destination_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai for Social Media?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Windsor.ai for Social Media in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.

_published_faq.name: Does Windsor.ai for Social Media MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Social Media requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Windsor.ai for Social Media?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Social Media is developed by Windsor.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
